note: Default weight presets (PRD US-007, FR-15). Each preset's five dimensions total 100. Ids match the Weights contract (lib/contracts/types.ts). Values are the team's judgement, not an external standard.

presets.label: Price-sensitive / mass market
presets.reason: Mass-market brands win on price and speed: a trend only matters if it sells at their price and is rising fast enough to test in weeks.

presets.label: Niche streetwear
presets.reason: Streetwear runs on community buzz and identity: a trend has to fit the brand's look and be talked about, while price matters less to loyal buyers.

presets.label: Fashion house / editorial
presets.reason: Houses set direction: what matters is fit with the house codes and what peer houses show on the runway, not price or short-term spikes.
